thread:
nina-park: Quick update 5B2 RegPack is live in pilot for private/VPC/on-prem installs. RegPack = a signed regulatory package + chain-of-custody log designed for audits (SOC2/HIPAA/PCI use cases). Pilot customers only for now.

david-li: Nice! How does this differ from the audit bundle we talked about before?

nina-park: Short answer: RegPack bundles produce a cryptographically signed chain-of-custody (events + checksums) and an immutable manifest with operator signatures. It also includes a "delivery receipt" option so customers can request an encrypted push to their S3 or on-prem object store with an MD5/SHA256 verification file.

infra-bot: Rollout: pilot start 1799004321, GA opt-in planned 1799600000 (2 weeks). Regions: us-west-2, eu-west-1 first.

mary-johnson: Security note: RegPack does NOT export private keys. It captures KMS/HSM usage metadata and audit log pointers only. Customers must enable HSM audit logging on their side for full HSM evidence.

legal-ops: Please ensure the attestation template included in RegPack has been signed-off by Legal before GA. We also need a short consent checkbox in the Console UI for Admins.

david-li: Any CLI for customers that are air-gapped? We need a reproducible workflow.

nina-park: Yes, CLI example for offline bundle generation:

```
rwctl regpack create --mode offline --out /tmp/regpack-1799004321.zip --license <LICENSE_KEY> --include-logs
```

And for direct push to S3:

```
rwctl regpack create --mode upload --dest s3://customer-audit/regpacks --encrypt --out-checksum sha256
```

infra-bot: Feature-flag: regpack.pilot enabled at 1799004335; gradual rollout to pilot accounts.

mary-johnson: Operational guidance: SEs should validate network CIDRs in the Console and collect a signed admin attestation PDF before generating RegPack. The Console will timestamp and sign the admin action.

partner-success: Heads-up for Partners: offer to co-run the SE walkthrough for pilot customers. We'll provide a one-hour deep-dive and a sample evidence checklist.

deploy-bot: Note: minor install change for packaging-mode in 0.12.3 (adds --bundle-compat flag). Patch scheduled for 1799004400.

david-li: Any compliance mapping included? e.g., which RegPack fields map to SOC2 sections?

nina-park: Yes, the RegPack manifest v1 includes a mapping file (regmap.json) that maps evidence objects to common control frameworks. We'll publish a short mapping doc in Confluence and a one-pager for Sales.

legal-ops: Action: Legal to review attestation template by 1799020000.

mary-johnson: Also: customers can redact specific hostnames/IPs in the bundle if they request it; redaction is logged and requires admin consent (for chain-of-custody integrity).

partner-success: Will coordinate on the one-pager and send to sales enablement.

nina-park: Thanks team. SEs: add interested customers to the pilot tracker by 1799025000. If anything pops up, ping me or @mary-johnson. :rocket:
